annotations.title: Duplicate Campaigns, Ad Sets or Ads

description: Copy campaigns, ad sets or ads in Ads Uploader, with previews, destination settings and account approvals. Copies stay within one ad account. A deep copy includes children; deepCopy: false copies only the root. Ad sets default to their source campaign and ads to their source ad set. rename supports {name}, {date} (UTC) and {index}; only roots are renamed unless renameChildren is true. Copy roots are PAUSED by default and children keep their source status unless childStatus:PAUSED. overrides change targeting, schedule, budget, bid and ad set settings on the copies. EU-targeted ad set copies need dsa_beneficiary and dsa_payor on the source ad set: Meta checks them at copy time, before overrides apply, and preview warns DSA_PAYOR_REQUIRED when they are missing. ads_duplicate_preview returns the full tree, skipped objects, warnings, executionPlan call counts and a resolvedRequest with a sourceFingerprint; ads_duplicate takes that resolvedRequest. Copies run serially, object by object, so Meta deep-copy child limits (3 synchronous / 51 async) do not apply. Copies follow the account's Agent Launch setting on the Account Permissions page, like launches; Agent Edit does not apply. Allowed starts a job (the hosted tool watches it for about 40 seconds, then returns still_running with a nextStep for ads_get_duplication), Approval returns status "pending_approval" with a reviewUrl and nothing is copied until it is approved in the Agent Inbox, and Off returns AGENT_LAUNCH_DISABLED. acknowledgeWarnings records review of that preview's warnings; ACTIVE copies need confirmSpend:true unless the account approval rule is none. SOURCE_CHANGED means the source, destination or copy intent changed since the preview; SOURCE_GONE and DESTINATION_GONE mean one is missing, deleted or archived. Running ads_duplicate again with the same request creates a second copy. Partial means some objects were created before a later step failed; each failure has stage, error and retry information. reason and runTitle label the copy in the Agent Inbox and reviewId adds it to an existing review. ads_duplicate_by_post reuses the existing Page post to keep its likes, comments and shares (social proof).

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Records that the warnings listed in the preview of this copy were reviewed. Needed when that preview returned warnings.

childStatus.description: Child objects inherit their source status by default, even under a PAUSED root. Use PAUSED to pause every copied child.

confirmSpend.description: Confirms that ACTIVE copies may start spending. Needed for ACTIVE copies unless the account approval rule is none.

adSetId.description: Ad set to copy ads into. Ad copies only; the campaign comes from this ad set.

campaignId.description: Campaign to copy ad sets into. Ad set copies only.

expanded.description: Expanded source IDs returned by preview. The server re-reads children at apply.

adsetSettings.description: Edit ad set settings. destination_type is read-only. Meta validate_only checks objective, destination, billing and event compatibility. Meta checks the EU beneficiary and payer when the copy is made. The copy request cannot carry them; overrides.adsetSettings is applied after. Set dsa_beneficiary and dsa_payor on the source ad set first (ads_edit_preview with set_adset_settings, or ads edit:adset-settings --dsa-beneficiary --dsa-payor), apply, then copy again. Or make a NEW ad set: use an ad in that ad set as the template with ads_create, copyFromAd and adSet.advertiser.eu = { advertiser, payer } (CLI: ads create --eu-advertiser <name> --eu-payer <name>), like the uploader's Edit Ad Set Settings > Advertiser & Payer tab.

attribution_spec.description: Standard attribution only. Turn incremental attribution off in a separate edit first.

roas_floor.description: Ad set only; 2.5 means 250%, stored as roas_average_floor 25000. Requires VALUE optimization and LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS at the budget owner.

budget.description: Budget in major account currency units. Ad set copies accept this when the destination campaign uses ad set budgets (ABO), including copies from campaign-budget (CBO) campaigns. Required for CBO-to-ABO ad set copies: preview returns ADSET_BUDGET_REQUIRED without overrides.budget. These copies have no budget of their own; the source campaign budget is never carried over. Their bid strategy defaults to LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP only when the source campaign is uncapped and the source ad set has no bid amount or constraints; otherwise supply overrides.bid.bid_strategy (ADSET_BID_STRATEGY_REQUIRED). Lifetime budgets require a future end time from the source ad set or overrides.schedule.end_time. When copying a CBO campaign, this overrides the copied campaign budget.

end_time.description: ISO timestamp with timezone. Null removes an end time.

targeting.description: Patch the current targeting without replacing unmentioned fields. Use ads_search_targeting for IDs. Preview includes per-path details and the full resulting audience, including every flexible_spec type. Advantage+ keeps a hard floor of 18-25 and uses age_range suggestions.

add.description: Adds to the source targeting. add.countries adds countries; it does not restrict targeting to them. To target only the US, add US and remove the other source countries with remove.countries; also remove any other source locations.

reason.description: One short note for the user explaining why (shown in their Agent Inbox).

reviewId.description: Add this copy to an existing review from ads_edit_preview or an earlier duplicate, so one run is approved together.

runTitle.description: Short name for this run. If the user names the run, use their exact words. Reuse it with the same reviewId. A run the user renamed keeps their name.

sourceFingerprint.description: Submit exactly the fingerprint returned by preview; required to apply.
